journey.b: A drawing, a photo, or a one-line brief — the system spins up a design with a draft techpack.
Bill of materials, size sets, construction and pricing — resolved and versioned.
The run is dispatched and tracked stitch by stitch, cost rolled up per piece.
Every piece leaves with a Digital Product Passport and lands at the door.

hero.title: From sketch to shipment, one system.
hero.subtitleHtml: Design with vetted artisans, track every stitch, and sell on your own storefront — custom clothing with verifiable provenance on the same rails brands like LeAtelier and Cici Label already trust.

items.line: The artisan behind every piece — by name.
items.detail: Every garment is linked to the individual who made it, not a factory. Their name, role and years on the loom travel with the piece.

items.line: Traced to the village and the loom.
items.detail: Origin is pinned to the village, the loom and the exact material lot — provenance becomes a fact, not a story.
Dye, weave and finish are recorded step by step, with timestamps and a quality check at every stage of the run.
